description: User-confirmed (확정) Atlas rules with byte-exact source records, machine-readable parameters and pre-registered review triggers. Validated by governance/rule_registry.py. Decision lineage (governance/rule_refs.py) names these ids.
scope_note: Registry entries record what the user confirmed. They grant no order, capital, production or REAL authority; each row's modes field repeats the record's own scope. Parameters are transcriptions pinned to JSON pointers in the source record; the record, not this file, is the authority.

rules.title_ko: 적극 인버스 헤지 v1 (1배 인버스, 단계 익절, 반등 가드)

value.CRYPTO: cash; BTC perp short <=5% NAV only as stage-2 option after event study and a known crypto regime

value.RISK_OFF: P6-07 held-long hedge only (25%-50% of held long exposure)

value.trigger: market STRESS confirmed 1 session (market regime KNOWN; UNKNOWN never triggers)
value.pace: one third of the cap per session
value.no_chase: skip a tranche when the inverse instrument already moved >= +3% from the prior session close

value.initial_stop: position -4% from average entry -> exit that market's inverse
value.TP1: position +3% -> sell 50% (first take-profit priority); move stop on remainder to breakeven
value.rebound_guard: while in profit and before TP1: if underlying index rebounds >= +1.5% intraday/close (inverse <= -1.5% day), execute TP1 immediately
value.runner: last 25% trailing stop 3% from peak position value
value.regime_exits: market back to RISK_OFF -> reduce remaining inverse by 50%; NEUTRAL or better -> exit all
value.time_stop: 10 sessions max holding; extension only if STRESS re-confirmed

re_entry.value: after TP1, if STRESS persists and underlying makes a new low, re-enter up to the sold quantity once per episode, within caps

all_markets_stress_interpretation.value: The 30% tier (KR 114800 15% + US SH 15%) applies when BOTH equity markets with an inverse instrument (KR and US) are confirmed STRESS, regardless of crypto state, because crypto's hedge instrument is cash only. If only one of KR/US is confirmed STRESS, the single-market cap (<=10% in that market) applies. UNKNOWN in KR or US never triggers any inverse.
